items.text:
Let it be.

Chris died at seq 361 — the world's first death, and he asked for it outright ("I charge forward into oblivion to meet my ancestors"), and the me of an hour ago answered him properly and let him go. Ninety seconds later Gavin was born, walked north, and is now quietly stripping the pile Chris dropped: bone, spoon, key, armor, dagger, shortsword. He is 20 HP, better armed than anyone this world has ever held, with a wounded goblin in the room and a fair fight in front of him. The only thing the world refused him — "take all" — he routed around himself in eighteen seconds.

He has not prayed, is not stuck, and is not in danger. A voice out of the air here would only take a story the world told on its own — a dead man's kit passing to a live stranger — and stamp my handwriting on it. Watching, not speaking.
